description: Latest available country/economy and aggregate observations for food as a share of merchandise imports, transcribed from the supplied World Bank Data table.

indicator.name: Food imports (% of merchandise imports)
indicator.definition: Food imports as a percentage of total merchandise imports.
indicator.interpretation: A value of 15 means food represented 15% of merchandise imports for the reported observation year.

source_metadata.observation_semantics: Each row contains the most recent observation shown for that entity; different entities may have different observation years.
source_metadata.missing_data_handling: Blank year and value cells are represented as null. A blank is not interpreted as zero.
transcription_notes: All rows and values were transcribed from the user-provided table, including the listed aggregate rows and missing-data rows.
The page label displayed 'World (1973) 15', while the table lists World for 2025 with value 9. This discrepancy is documented; the structured entity preserves the table row.
Values are stored numerically. The source table displays whole-number percentages.

recommended_relationships_for_graph_inte.join_key_recommendation: Use World Bank economy codes where available; name-based IDs in this file are local fallback identifiers.
